Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s)

SCOPE OF WORK: 1.1 Name of the work: Annual Maintenance Contract for AC Plants and Water coolers of various makes Over MAQ area for a period of 2 Years. 1.2 Place of work Execution All over Mangalore Central (MAQ) Electrical power depot section area. 1.3 Details of Work: 1. This is a Comprehensive AMC for maintenance of AC plants, Water coolers including rep lacements listed hereunder and installed in MAQ depot area in MYS Division. The maintena nce SCHEDULE as per annexure-1 & Annexure-2 enclosed includes: (a) Regular Service/Preventive Maintenance, once in Month (b) Break down maintenance (c) Replacement of Capacitors (d) Replacement of accessories (e) Gas supply, charging of gas & leakage arresting in condenser coil & evaporator coil. 2. The following Items/Spares are however excluded from the Scope of AMC (a) AC Plant outer shell (b) Front grill (c) Cooling coil (d) Blower motor (e) PCB Board (Need based item to be operated only if it is certified by OEM/ Authorized de aler that the PCB is irreparable.
